description: Selected projects by Md. Muhaiminul Islam (Jamee) in embedded systems, autonomous robots, SLAM, IoT, computer vision, and AI.
heading: Projects
intro: Ten project entries from a portfolio spanning embedded systems, robotics, IoT, computer vision, and artificial intelligence.

projects.title: Four-Storey Elevator Control System
projects.description: A dual-Arduino elevator controller using an I²C master–slave architecture and the SCAN scheduling algorithm. The system coordinates motors, displays, request handling, door control, obstacle detection, overload protection, and manual safety overrides.

projects.title: Autonomous Garbage Detection & Collection Robot
projects.description: An autonomous robot that combines deep-learning detection with SLAM, LiDAR and sonar sensing, Kalman filtering, and A* path planning to locate, approach, collect, and store waste in real time.
projects.imageAlt: Autonomous garbage detection and collection robot

projects.title: Land Mine & Human Detection Robot
projects.description: An IoT-enabled safety robot combining GPS, GSM, environmental and metal sensors, image processing, and live video to detect hazards, identify human presence, and transmit alerts with coordinates.
projects.imageAlt: Land mine and human detection robot

projects.title: Autonomous Self-Driving Car with Text Translation
projects.description: A ROS and computer-vision vehicle that performs lane and object detection, localization, route planning, and English–Bangla road-text translation using a Raspberry Pi camera platform.
projects.imageAlt: Autonomous self-driving car with text translation

projects.title: PID-Controlled Fast Line-Following Robot
projects.description: A high-speed robot built around a six-sensor infrared array, Arduino Nano, custom PCB, and L298N motor driver. Dynamic PID correction minimizes path deviation while preserving speed and stability.

projects.title: Human-Rescue & Fire-Fighting Robot
projects.description: An emergency-response robot using IoT, environmental and infrared sensing, and image processing to navigate hazardous spaces, detect fire and trapped people, and transmit live situational data to operators.

projects.title: AI-Based Smart Notice Board
projects.description: A personalized notice-delivery platform that recognizes users with facial recognition, retrieves relevant information through a server and database, and displays tailored updates through a web interface.
